race.comment: NARALINGA (4) has been mixing his form this prep but boasts peaks that are superior to the rest. Is drawn to get back but has a good record here and can pounce on them late. GUSTY WAY (3) had the better of NARALINGA last time but meets him 2.5kgs worse now. Form hard to knock and his record over this trip is strong but he will have to raise the bar again. HALLIWELL (1) is going better than her form reads and gets a nice drop in grade on the quick back-up but the draw is awful. Will need some luck but is up to this. AQUAHOLIC (7) hasn't won for a long time but has turned in some good efforts this campaign and boasts a handy record over this track and trip. Not underestimating. TERRALIGHT (6) is ticking along in superb form as she shoots for the hat-trick. Have to include.
